units: m, kg, s, K, J, W; no physical material
quadrature: 2x2x2 Gauss, exact for quadratic enthalpy of trilinear HEX8 temperature
birth_rule: Preserve all existing nodal values, including shared interface nodes. Initialise genuinely new nodes to 350K. Integrate birth enthalpy from this predeclared interpolated field; do not assume shared nodes are 350K.
source_normalization: Full-space integral = 2*factor*efficiency*power; finite box integral uses product of error-function fractions.
time_method: Backward Euler: Delta H = dt*integral(Q_h) - rho*cp_slope/2*integral((T_end-T_begin)^2), with adiabatic exterior. Birth is applied at the beginning of the ending-time-labelled step. Continuous-time error must decrease under frozen time refinement.
